title: Agent HTML views (ADR 0032)
description: An agent offers a frozen export of a workspace HTML file or directory; the person opens it in a panel or an own tab on the view's own origin. App-origin messages: GET /api/v1/views[?conversation_id=pi:UUID][&cursor=…] (the person's views, or one conversation's, a page at a time; an empty 204 when the installation has no view origin, which means views are not offered) and POST /auth/view (a one-time URL that opens one view on its own host) and GET /api/v1/views/<view_id>/zip (the view's frozen files as one stored zip for the owner's session: an attachment the page names, with a sandbox CSP, nosniff and no-store; 404 where the installation has no view origin or the view is gone). An offer is always a conversation's notice carrying a view.

view.description: One frozen export. The title is agent text, shown as data. Files and bytes describe what the export holds; nothing says the person has seen it.

source.description: The absolute path on the host the agent offered from, resolved when it offered. A re-offer of the same file or folder is a newer version of one report. The owner's fact only: the view origin's export summary and every public address leave it out. Views offered before it was recorded have none.

list.description: GET /api/v1/views: one page of the person's views, or of one conversation's (conversation_id), newest first. A page that is not the last names next_cursor; the next page is read with cursor set to it.

handoffRequest.description: POST /auth/view: the view to open. The gateway checks who asks; the person's daemon answers whether the view exists when its host reads it.

handoff.description: A one-minute, single-use URL on the view's own host; opening it sets that host's view cookie and goes to the view's entry.
